item.title: San Rafael Middle School Student of the Week
item.description: Lilly Allred Lilly is the daughter of Trudy and Bodee Allred of Castle Dale. Her favorite classes are FACS and Digital Literacy. She enjoys riding horses, riding four wheelers, and playing volleyball. In the future, she wants to go to college and get her own house. Lilly is a very nice person to everyone.
